mapper.select: SELECT pc.comment_id AS commentId, pc.property_id AS propertyId, pc.user_id AS userId, u.name AS nickname, pc.content, pc.created_at AS createdAt, pc.updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN pc.user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isMine FROM property_comment pc JOIN users u ON u.user_id = pc.user_id WHERE pc.property_id = #{propertyId} AND pc.del_yn = 'N' AND u.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY pc.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO property_comment (property_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{propertyId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE property_comment SET del_yn = 'Y' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_yn = 'N'
